headline: Claude-assisted hack of OpenAI staff accounts nudges catastrophic risk
body: A quiet day. A three-person white-hat team used Claude Opus 5 to chain bugs from an OpenAI forum upload into logged-in access to employee accounts, a reminder of AI-boosted hacking that raises Catastrophic Risk and nudges Self-Destruction. Anthropic giving Faculty employee-level access for independent evaluations was a small plus for Alignment & Control. Horizon Balance edged to -7.15.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.1 from the Hacktron hack (+0.16); Protector God +0.1 and Gatekeeper +0.1 from Anthropic's Faculty evaluation deal (+0.07 and +0.06).
